scope_note: Targeted deep research with full access status and limitations preserved for each source.

neuroscience_and_psychology.scope: Gateway-adjacent neuroscience and psychology; targeted evidence review, not an exhaustive systematic review

sources.authors: Ruth Maria Ingendoh; Ella S. Posny; Angela Heine
sources.title: Binaural beats to entrain the brain? A systematic review of the effects of binaural beat stimulation on brain oscillatory activity, and the implications for psychological research and intervention
sources.access: Full article consulted
sources.finding: 5 supportive, 8 negative, 1 mixed; heterogeneous methods prevent a settled entrainment conclusion.
sources.limitations: Small samples; inconsistent operationalization and analysis; no full Gateway curriculum test.

sources.authors: Miguel Garcia-Argibay; Miguel A. Santed; Jose M. Reales
sources.title: Efficacy of binaural auditory beats in cognition, anxiety, and pain perception: a meta-analysis
sources.access: NLM abstract consulted; full text not reviewed
sources.finding: Overall Hedges' g=0.45 for pooled cognitive, anxiety, and pain outcomes.
sources.limitations: Mixed outcomes; pooled result is not proof of mechanism or Gateway-wide efficacy.

sources.authors: Iram Fatima; Sahar Zaidi; Habiba Sundus; Md Farhan Alam; Huma Parveen; Sohrab Ahmad Khan
sources.title: Efficacy of theta binaural beat therapy on pain, cognition and anxiety in adults: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
sources.access: NLM abstract consulted; full text not reviewed
sources.design: 13 RCTs, 630 adults; pain synthesis 4 RCTs, 173 adults
sources.finding: Pain SMD=-0.53 (95% CI -0.84 to -0.23), low-certainty evidence.
sources.limitations: Anxiety/cognition not pooled; small pain evidence base.

sources.authors: Hector D. Orozco Perez; Guillaume Dumas; Alexandre Lehmann
sources.title: Binaural Beats through the Auditory Pathway: From Brainstem to Connectivity Patterns
sources.access: Full article consulted
sources.design: 16 adults, within-subject single-blind active control; 7/40 Hz
sources.finding: Auditory neural responses without mood change; binaural cortical entrainment weaker than monaural.
sources.limitations: Small, brief experiment; not Gateway training.

sources.authors: Susan Dabu-Bondoc; Nalini Vadivelu; Judy Benson; Danielle Perret; Zeev N. Kain
sources.title: Hemispheric synchronized sounds and perioperative analgesic requirements
sources.access: NLM abstract consulted; full text not reviewed
sources.design: RCT, 60 surgical outpatients; Hemi-Sync/music/blank tape, 20 per group
sources.finding: Less fentanyl, lower postoperative pain, earlier discharge with Hemi-Sync.
sources.limitations: Small clinical trial; abstract lacks effect magnitudes; no paranormal outcomes.

sources.authors: Susan Dabu-Bondoc; Jacqueline Drummond-Lewis; Dorothy Gaal; Maryanne McGinn; Alison A. Caldwell-Andrews; Zeev N. Kain
sources.title: Hemispheric synchronized sounds and intraoperative anesthetic requirements
sources.access: NLM abstract consulted; full text not reviewed
sources.design: RCT, 60 surgical patients; Hemi-Sync 31, blank tape 29
sources.finding: No reduction in propofol induction or maintenance requirements.
sources.limitations: Different endpoint from N05; not a direct replication or proof of universal ineffectiveness.

sources.authors: V. C. Goessl; J. E. Curtiss; S. G. Hofmann
sources.title: The effect of heart rate variability biofeedback training on stress and anxiety: a meta-analysis
sources.access: NLM abstract consulted; full text not reviewed
sources.finding: Stress/anxiety g=.81 pre-post, g=.83 against controls.
sources.limitations: Authors call for better-controlled studies; self-reported endpoints.

sources.title: Adjunctive use of hypnosis for clinical pain: a systematic review and meta-analysis
sources.access: Full article text returned by indexed primary-source search; NLM abstract also consulted
sources.design: 70 studies pooled, 6078 participants; searches through January 2024
sources.finding: Small additional analgesic effect with usual care; overall certainty very low.
sources.limitations: Attention controls and reporting often inadequate; adjunct type matters.

sources.title: Meditation Programs for Psychological Stress and Well-being: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
sources.access: Original JAMA article consulted
sources.finding: Small-to-moderate anxiety, depression, pain improvements; no established superiority to active treatments.
sources.limitations: Older synthesis; excluded audio-only programs without teacher presence.

sources.authors: Olaf Blanke; Stephanie Ortigue; Theodor Landis; Margitta Seeck
sources.title: Stimulating illusory own-body perceptions
sources.access: NLM abstract consulted
sources.design: Repeated focal brain stimulation in one epilepsy patient
sources.limitations: Single clinical case; cannot explain every OBE.

sources.title: Real-time dialogue between experimenters and dreamers during REM sleep
sources.access: Original article and NSF-hosted text retrieved through indexed primary-source search
sources.finding: 29 correct replies among 158 attempts during signal-verified lucid dreams.
sources.limitations: Most attempts had no response; ordinary sensory input, not telepathy.

sources.authors: Miguel Farias; Everton Maraldi; K. C. Wallenkampf; Giancarlo Lucchetti
sources.title: Adverse events in meditation practices and meditation-based therapies: a systematic review
sources.access: Publisher abstract and university-hosted article summary consulted
sources.limitations: Heterogeneous definitions and monitoring; not a Gateway-specific or personal risk.

sources.authors: Jared A. Nielsen; Brandon A. Zielinski; Michael A. Ferguson; Janet E. Lainhart; Jeffrey S. Anderson
sources.title: An evaluation of the left-brain vs. right-brain hypothesis with resting state functional connectivity magnetic resonance imaging
sources.access: NLM abstract consulted
sources.design: Resting fMRI data from 1011 people, ages 7-29
sources.finding: Local lateralization without global left/right-brain phenotype.
sources.limitations: Does not directly test Gateway or deny hemispheric specialization.

sources.authors: Bigna Lenggenhager; Tej Tadi; Thomas Metzinger; Olaf Blanke
sources.title: Video ergo sum: manipulating bodily self-consciousness
sources.access: NLM abstract consulted
sources.finding: Body identification and experienced self-location shifted toward virtual body.
sources.limitations: Not identical to all spontaneous OBEs; sample size not checked.

sources.authors: National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health
sources.title: Meditation and Mindfulness: Effectiveness and Safety
sources.date: 2022-06 (displayed page update; live content subsequently revised)
sources.access: Official live guidance consulted on 2026-09-08
sources.finding: Potential benefits and uncertain safety; check instructors and retain conventional care.
sources.limitations: Broad meditation guidance, not a Gateway evaluation.

sources.authors: National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health
sources.title: Relaxation Techniques: What You Need To Know
sources.access: Official live guidance consulted
sources.finding: Describes relaxation methods and occasional distress; rare worsening in vulnerable groups.
sources.limitations: Do not portray broad relaxation cautions as binaural-specific established risks.

history_physics_and_remote_viewing.scope: Targeted narrative review of source provenance, physics, and remote-viewing evidence; not exhaustive systematic review or raw-data reanalysis.

sources.title: Analysis and Assessment of Gateway Process
sources.author: Wayne M. McDonnell, Department of the Army
sources.access: CIA URL failed or redirected during the original review. Government-preserved GovInfo facsimile downloaded; first leaf and printed pages 7–13, 26, 28 visually read; supplementary OCR searched for resonance passages.
sources.supports: Army authorship, argument and bibliography; exact dimensional inconsistency in §19 printed p12.
sources.limits: Officer assessment and theoretical synthesis, not a controlled demonstration. Requested release has 29 scanned leaves; printed p25 absent. Historical printed pages differ from PDF leaf numbers.
sources.availability_note_2026_10_25: CIA direct PDF redirected to system maintenance during spot-checking; use the local facsimile and GovInfo catalog.

sources.title: GovInfo content details: Analysis and Assessment of Gateway Process
sources.author: U.S. Government Publishing Office
sources.access: Full metadata page read
sources.supports: Government authors Army Department/Defense Department; preserved source content may not reflect current policy.
sources.limits: Generated citation defaults to January 1; use document's visible June 9 date instead.

sources.title: Found: Page 25 of the CIA’s Gateway Report on Astral Projection
sources.author: Thobey Campion
sources.access: Full relevant provenance passage read
sources.supports: Author reports receiving complete report from Monroe Institute.
sources.limits: Does not establish reason for original omission or scientific validity. Several scientific descriptions in article should not be relied on.

sources.title: Full Gateway report supplied via Monroe Institute / DocumentCloud
sources.author: Wayne M. McDonnell; separate archival copy
sources.access: Supplementary facsimile downloaded and confirmed as 30 scanned leaves; supplementary OCR searched.
sources.supports: Restored printed page 25 can be transcribed with separate source label.
sources.limits: Do not silently replace CIA/GovInfo release or claim CIA released the missing page. Check the facsimile for page-level wording.
sources.availability_note_2026_10_25: Direct DocumentCloud S3 URL returned HTTP 403 in the audit tool; local preserved copy remains available.

sources.title: An Assessment of the Evidence for Psychic Functioning
sources.author: Jessica Utts
sources.type: Primary expert evaluation for 1995 AIR review
sources.access: Full text read, including statistical rationale, methodological criteria, study summaries, and limitations.
sources.supports: Affirmative case and training/psychokinesis qualifications.
sources.limits: Copyright 1995 Utts; Positive interpretation is disputed, not consensus; not a Gateway trial.
sources.availability_note_2026_10_25: The original UCI author-hosted URL failed current access checks. The corresponding section was located in the complete AIR report hosted by George Washington University’s National Security Archive; this verifies availability without claiming a new full-report audit.

sources.title: Evaluation of Program on Anomalous Mental Phenomena
sources.author: Ray Hyman
sources.type: Primary expert evaluation for 1995 AIR review
sources.access: Full text read, especially shared findings, judge and replication concerns, operational cautions, conclusions.
sources.supports: Accepts nonchance SAIC effects and improved controls; disputes paranormal inference; asks independent replication.
sources.limits: Do not say Hyman demonstrated a specific flaw explaining SAIC results; he expressly did not.
sources.availability_note_2026_10_25: The original UCI author-hosted URL failed current access checks. The corresponding section was located in the complete AIR report hosted by George Washington University’s National Security Archive; this verifies availability without claiming a new full-report audit.

sources.title: Response to Ray Hyman’s Report
sources.author: Jessica Utts
sources.access: Full reply read
sources.supports: Affirmative counterargument about prior evidence and standards for accepting statistical effects.
sources.limits: Expert advocacy, not independent replication

The corresponding section was located in the complete AIR report hosted by George Washington University’s National Security Archive; this verifies availability without claiming a new full-report audit.

sources.title: Satellite observations of Schumann resonances in the Earth’s ionosphere
sources.author: Fernando Simões, Robert Pfaff, Henry Freudenreich
sources.type: Primary satellite observational research, Geophysical Research Letters 38
sources.access: Full article read at publisher; NTRS PDF failed.
sources.supports: Lightning-generated electromagnetic cavity modes, measured frequencies and observational context.
sources.limits: No test of human/brain resonance or telepathy. Distinction from body oscillation is our explicit analytical inference.
sources.alternate_url_note: NASA-hosted preprint, titled “Observation of Schumann Resonances in the Earth’s Ionosphere”; the publisher DOI identifies the version of record.

sources.title: The Holographic Brain with Karl Pribram, Ph.D.
sources.author: Karl Pribram interviewed by Jeffrey Mishlove
sources.access: Interview transcript read
sources.supports: Holonomic representation, distributed patterns, Gabor/Fourier ideas and relation to Bohm's implicate order.
sources.limits: Interview is explanatory, not outcome evidence. no claim this proves a universal information channel.

sources.title: A Suggested Interpretation of the Quantum Theory in Terms of Hidden Variables. II
sources.author: David Bohm
sources.access: Publisher abstract/metadata read; corresponding Part I verified through OSTI https://www.osti.gov/biblio/4409358
sources.supports: Genuine measurement and distant-correlation theory must be distinguished from report's wider metaphysics.
sources.limits: Not a full equation-level reading or a consciousness study

sources.title: The Large N Limit of Superconformal Field Theories and Supergravity
sources.author: Juan M. Maldacena
sources.access: Author abstract and metadata read
sources.supports: Modern AdS/CFT holography is a specific physical duality, later than 1983.
sources.limits: Not a proof of literal cosmic memory or consciousness access. Abstract-level review only,

sources.title: 2022 CODATA adjustment: Fundamental Physical Constants, Extensive Listing
sources.author: NIST / CODATA
sources.access: Table entries for Planck length and time read
sources.supports: Planck length 1.616255(18) × 10^-35 m; length distinct from speed.
sources.limits: Constants do not establish a proven minimum length or a consciousness threshold. Dimensional criticism is our analysis.

sources.title: The Nobel Prize in Physics 2022: Press release
sources.author: Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences
sources.access: Press release and popular scientific background read
sources.supports: Entangled photon experiments and Bell inequality violations.
sources.limits: Does not establish mind over matter or Gateway.

sources.title: Quantum teleportation
sources.author: IBM Quantum Learning
sources.access: Protocol and explanation read
sources.supports: Entangled pair plus two bits classical communication; state transfer distinct from matter transfer.
sources.limits: Tutorial, not a Gateway experiment

sources.title: Decoherence and the transition from quantum to classical — REVISITED
sources.author: Wojciech H. Zurek
sources.access: Abstract/metadata read
sources.supports: Environment interactions can act as monitoring and produce decoherence.
sources.limits: Abstract-level review; does not resolve all measurement interpretations.

sources.title: The importance of quantum decoherence in brain processes
sources.author: Max Tegmark
sources.access: Abstract and publication metadata read
sources.supports: Model-dependent brain decoherence times much shorter than neural processing times.
sources.limits: Not universal disproof of quantum biology; modeling challenged in P17.

sources.title: Quantum computation in brain microtubules: Decoherence and biological feasibility
sources.author: Scott Hagan, Stuart R. Hameroff, Jack A. Tuszyński
sources.access: Author abstract and APS publication metadata read
sources.supports: Challenges Tegmark's assumptions and gives longer model-dependent estimates.
sources.limits: Not experimental verification of Orch OR, Gateway, remote viewing or survival.

sources.title: Ask Molly: Did CIA Really Study Psychic Powers?
sources.author: Central Intelligence Agency, drawing on CIA History Staff
sources.access: Full page read
sources.supports: Records from CIA, DIA and Army archived together; CIA did not restore program after 1995 operational assessment.
sources.limits: Popular retrospective simplifies program history; don't overinterpret its phrase about defying randomness as official proof of psychic mechanism.

sources.title: AIR operational conclusions reproduced with Ray Hyman's discussion in Skeptical Inquirer
sources.author: Michael D. Mumford, Andrew M. Rose, David A. Goslin (original AIR excerpt)
sources.type: Reproduction of primary AIR conclusion excerpt within 4-page published item
sources.access: Published excerpt read. Full CIA 206-leaf archive and FAS mirrors failed web access.
sources.supports: No demonstrated actionable operational value in examined program, contamination/context and irrelevant material concerns.
sources.limits: Do not claim full AIR archival review completed. avoid long quotes.

sources.title: Remote Viewing: A 1974–2022 Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
sources.author: Patrizio E. Tressoldi and Debra Lynne Katz
sources.type: Primary published meta-analysis, Journal of Scientific Exploration 37(3), 467–489
sources.access: Publisher abstract/metadata read, author-posted PDF excerpts surfaced in search; full PDF access failed.
sources.supports: 36 studies, 40 effect sizes, .34 pooled effect (.22–.45 CI) after outlier exclusion, favorable interpretation.
sources.limits: Abstract-level result verification; not independently audited raw data; no-publication-bias finding is not proof of absence. Not direct Gateway efficacy.
sources.availability_note_2026_10_25: Publisher PDF opened for a spot-check of reported study counts and pooled estimates; this does not upgrade the original review to a full methods or raw-data audit.

sources.title: Follow-up on the U.S. Central Intelligence Agency’s (CIA) remote viewing experiments
sources.author: Álex Escolà-Gascón, James Houran, Neil Dagnall, Kenneth Drinkwater, Andrew Denovan
sources.type: Primary study, Brain and Behavior 13(6), e3026
sources.access: Methods, results, limitations and data availability statement read
sources.supports: 634 participants, forced-choice modified protocol, reported positive anomaly; EI/belief associations.
sources.limits: Belief/experience groups and target format covary; not randomized EI training or a Gateway trial.

sources.title: Study preregistration: an early example and analysis
sources.author: Richard Wiseman and Caroline Watt
sources.access: University repository abstract read; full-text methods/results and limitation excerpts in PMC search and author manuscript search. PMC and publisher open intermittently failed.
sources.supports: 16/100 supported hypotheses preregistered vs 95/204 non-preregistered; experiment-level post-hoc result 14/42 vs 59/93.
sources.limits: Broad parapsychology, not Gateway/RV-specific; observational comparison; second author runs studied registry.
sources.availability_note_2026_10_25: Open article checked for reported preregistration counts; original access scope is retained.
